mentions.name: mot
mentions.description: A macOS terminal emulator with a cmd+space fullscreen quake-style overlay, quick-terminal tabs, and low input lag, built as an alternative to Ghostty and iTerm2.
mentions.problem: Ghostty was taking too long to add quick-terminal tabs, which the author relied on as their main iTerm2 workflow, and they wanted a cmd+space fullscreen quake overlay with low input lag.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on a macOS terminal because Ghostty is taking too long to add quick-terminal tabs which was my main workflow in iterm2.

All I wanted was cmd+space fullscreen quake-overlay with low input lag so I made it. It fits my workflow exactly so it might be a bit weird for someone else.
mentions.author: mmarc
